---
name: 🐛 Bug Report (English)
about: Report a software bug or unexpected behavior to help us improve.
title: '[BUG] - Short and descriptive title of the issue'
labels: bug
assignees: ''
---

## 📝 1. Bug Description
A clear and concise description of what the bug is. 

* **Actual Behavior:** What is currently happening?
* **Expected Behavior:** What should have happened?

---

## 👣 2. Steps to Reproduce
Provide the exact steps to reproduce the behavior so the development team can test it:
1. Go to '...'
2. Click on '...'
3. Scroll down to '...'
4. See the error: '...'

---

## 📸 3. Visual Evidence (Screenshots / Video)
> **Tip:** You can drag and drop images or paste (Ctrl+V) screenshots directly here.
*Please add screenshots, GIFs, or video recordings of the issue if available.*

---

## 💻 4. Environment Details
Please provide information about the environment where the bug occurred:
* **Device:** [e.g., Laptop, PC]
* **Operating System:** [e.g., Windows 11, Windows 10]
* **Browser / App Version:** [e.g., Google Chrome v122, Safari, Mobile App v2.1]

---

## ⚠️ 5. Impact & Severity
* **Is this blocking your work?** [ Yes / No ]
* **Severity Level:** [ Low / Medium / High / Critical ]
